full-cases.jsonl.source: (do (def LITE_MODE false) (do (do (assert (.equiv :foo :foo)) (assert (.equiv 'foo 'foo)) (when-not LITE_MODE       (assert (.equiv {:foo 1 :bar 2} {:foo 1 :bar 2}))) (assert (.equiv [1 2 3] [1 2 3])) (assert (.equiv '(1 2 3) '(1 2 3))) (assert (.equiv (map inc [1 2 3]) (map inc [1 2 3]))) (when-not LITE_MODE       (assert (.equiv #{:cat :dog :bird} #{:cat :dog :bird})))) true))

complete_body_phase_mapping.rationale: Complete original non-lite Object equiv body with all seven assertions and LITE_MODE false; only cljs.test testing/is become executing do/assert and the body returns true after all assertions. Every .equiv call, collection literal and lazy computation is preserved. Ordinary applications execute in Node/QuickJS; macros independently compute the full body in QuickJS before expansion.
